objectives.title: Capture the Beacons
objectives.description: Periodically two Beacons will activate. Capture both to fill your Holding Cell with Zerg.

objectives.title: Fill Holding Cells
objectives.description: Once either Holding Cell fills, both open and unleash waves of Zerg at each team's base.

objectives.title: Zerg Rush
objectives.description: Hold out against the enemy's Zerg while helping yours. They will attack Heroes, so engage cautiously.
